author: nerfgun2002
body:
Dear Avicus,
I'm Back. So recently, I have appealed, like after 4 months and the avicus support accepted it. It was very nice of them to have given me a chance to come back and play on the server. I hope you guys will welcome me back and not be very bad to me or reply saying that I am bad and I should leave. Say HI! if you see me on avicus, whether you know me the last time or whether you are new to the server. I have not been on avicus in quite a while, so I don't know whether a lot of things have changed. Please guide me and help me if I require assistance. I hope I don't get depressed because my country and I have been going through a period of mourning for our lost of our founding father. If you do not know, I am from Singapore. #RIPLeeKuanYew
Once again Thank You for giving me a chance.
If the world continues spinning, so will I.
-nerfgun2002
